item.title: Bethalto fire: Downed powerlines from high winds caused fire and outages
item.description: A fast-moving grass fire driven by strong winds swept through parts of Bethalto, Illinois, Sunday evening, damaging homes, straining emergency resources, and leaving hundreds without electricity.

item.title: Man ruled unfit for murder trial, confined to state custody
item.description: Earlier this month, a Manchester man was remanded to state custody after a judge said he was unfit to stand trial for killing his father.

item.title: Heating things up but storms will usher in another cool down late week
item.description: ST. LOUIS - A few spotty light rain showers have rolled through the St. Louis region overnight. As they move out, skies will become partly cloudy Tuesday. It will be warmer Tuesday, with highs in the mid-60s. Wake up temperatures will be in the 40s Wednesday. Temperatures are expected to soar well into the 70s [...]

item.title: Sam Page expected to announce several service reductions
item.description: St. Louis County Executive Sam Page is expected to announce several service reductions, including the closure of three county buildings on Fridays and the cancellation of a traditional holiday event, due to a period of conflict between the county executive and the council over the current year's budget.

item.title: New Safe Haven Baby Box to open in north St. Louis County
item.description: ST. LOUIS COUNTY, Mo. - A new Safe Haven Baby Box is set for dedication Tuesday afternoon at the Florissant Fire House in North St. Louis County. The resource provides parents in crisis a safe, secure and anonymous way to surrender an infant under Missouri law. The installation marks the first Safe Haven Baby Box [...]

item.title: This is the St. Louis Cardinals' expected 2026 Opening Day roster
item.description: It appears this year's St. Louis Cardinals' Opening Day roster will feature 13 position players and 13 pitchers, largely youth- and future-focused.

item.title: Child shot, 'critically injured' in north St. Louis
item.description: A child was shot and "critically injured" Tuesday afternoon in north St. Louis, police say.

item.title: Goose on duty: O'Fallon PD's unofficial mascot is back for third year
item.description: O’FALLON, Ill. — A familiar feathered friend has returned once again to the O’Fallon Public Safety Facility in Illinois, marking the third year in a row that the goose has picked the site on their property to lay her eggs.

item.title: Pediatrician who traded sex for prescriptions blames Holocaust; judge rejects excuse
item.description: For years, pediatrician Craig Spiegel worked out of a medical building near DePaul Hospital in Bridgeton, where patients reported the doctor offered prescriptions for sex or sexual pictures.

item.title: Police seek public’s help in child abuse case involving St. Charles County couple
item.description: The investigation into a St. Charles County couple charged with child sex abuse and exploitation is far from over. Authorities want to hear from parents whose children may have had contact with Joshua and Amber Sinkler.

item.title: Illinois officials warn of text message scam targeting drivers
item.description: Illinois state officials have warned drivers to be aware of a text message scam that threatens them with unpaid fines and license suspensions, and prompts them to enter personal and financial information on a fraudulent website.

item.title: Eastbound I-44 shut down after overnight crash near downtown St. Louis
item.description: ST. LOUIS - All lanes on eastbound Interstate 44 were shutdown Wednesday morning after a crash near downtown St. Louis. According to the Missouri Department of Transportation (MoDOT), the crash occurred shortly before 5 a.m. on eastbound I-44 past Park Avenue. item.title: 'CardVault by Tom Brady' to open St. Louis store at Ballpark Village
item.description: "CardVault by Tom Brady," a sports card and trading card shop inspired by the seven-time Super Bowl champion, is coming soon to St. Louis, specifically at Ballpark Village.

item.title: Washington County man faces multiple charges for propositioning minor
item.description: A Potosi-area man has been charged with propositioning a juvenile for oral sex.

item.title: How to watch St. Louis Cardinals games in 2026: Cardinals.TV and beyond
item.description: Major League Baseball is set to produce and distribute every Cardinals regional broadcast during the 2026 season through MLB.TV, locally branded as Cardinals.TV.
